conversation:
Doctor: Hello. Could you tell me your age and gender, and what brings you in today?
Patient: Hello. I'm 48 years old, and I'm a female. I'm here because my right elbow has been hurting a lot since yesterday. I felt a pop when I was lifting a box while moving, and it's been throbbing ever since.
Doctor: Could you please describe the nature of the pain in your right elbow? Is it sharp, dull, or throbbing? Have you noticed any swelling or bruising?
Patient: The pain is throbbing, and it gets worse when I take the ice off. There's some swelling and redness around the elbow, but no bruising that I can see. It hurts when I try to bend or straighten my arm.
Doctor: Have you experienced any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your right arm or hand since the injury?
Patient: No, I haven't felt any numbness, tingling, or weakness in my arm or hand. My fingers move fine, and I don't have any pain there. The issue is really just around my elbow.
Doctor: Have you experienced any prior elbow injuries, surgeries, or conditions such as arthritis or tendinitis?
Patient: No, I don't have any prior elbow injuries or surgeries. The only surgery I've had was on my neck, and I don't have any history of arthritis or tendinitis in my elbow. This is the first time I've had this kind of pain.
Doctor: Could you describe the exact location of the popping sensation and whether there was any immediate deformity or inability to move the elbow at the time of injury?
Patient: The popping sensation happened right here at my elbow, on the outside, when I lifted the box up. There wasn't any deformity or inability to move it right away, but it started hurting pretty badly after that.
Doctor: Have you experienced any instability, locking, or crepitus in the elbow joint since the injury?
Patient: No, I haven't felt any instability, locking, or crepitus in my elbow joint since the injury. It just hurts when I move it, especially when bending or straightening my arm.
Doctor: Have you undergone any imaging studies such as X-rays, MRI, or ultrasound for your elbow since the injury?
Patient: No, I haven't had any imaging studies for my elbow since the injury. The doctor just looked at the X-rays here, and they didn't show any fractures, but there was some swelling on the lateral side. I wasn't sure what that meant, but he said it's probably just inflammation.
Doctor: Have you been experiencing any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your hand or fingers since the injury?
Patient: No, I haven't been experiencing any numbness, tingling, or weakness in my hand or fingers since the injury. The pain is mainly around my elbow, and my fingers move fine without any discomfort.
Doctor: Have you experienced any previous episodes of similar elbow pain or injury, and if so, how were they managed?
Patient: No, I haven't experienced any previous episodes of similar elbow pain or injury. This is the first time I've had this kind of pain, and I didn't manage it before because it just happened yesterday. I've only been using ice and ibuprofen so far.
Doctor: Have you experienced any locking, clicking, or instability in the elbow joint since the injury?
Patient: No, I haven't experienced any locking, clicking, or instability in the elbow joint since the injury. It just hurts when I move it, especially when bending or straightening my arm.
